title: Martha's Vineyard Boat Rentals
specs: Only the licensed and contracted operator may captain the vessel, and they must be over the age of 21
includes: All required U.S.C.G Required Safety Equipment
blurb: Rent boats equipped with GPS, VHF radio, and safety gear including kid life jackets. The fleet includes classic Boston Whalers and a 13' rigid inflatable suitable for fishing, watersports, and beach tending. Orientation and check-out are required before departure.
extraNote: Boats must be docked or moored at night to a physical dock or permitted mooring, anchoring is not allowed · Boats cannot operate from 1/2 after sunset to 1/2 before sunrise (no nighttime use) · Capacity is limited to the capacity listed on this site or the USCG Weight Rating Placard · Boats are restricted from: Woods Hole Passage and Buzzards Bay, Nantucket, Muskeget Channel and south of the Islands · Operating under the influence of alcohol or drugs is strictly forbidden · There is a $2500 Damage deductible if damage is to occur · A check-out and vessel orientation will be performed prior to departure and is required · Fuel must be refilled at Safe Harbor Vineyard Haven at time of return an
